title: ZATCA API invoice payload
description: One invoice as accepted by zatca_api. The same object is used whether you POST it to create_invoice or publish it in a feed we poll. Key names are also matched case- and separator-insensitively, and a number of aliases are accepted, but the names below are canonical -- build to these.

external_id.description: Your unique, STABLE identifier for this document. Send the same value on a retry and you get the existing invoice back instead of a duplicate. If this changes between retries, duplicates are created.

customer.description: Customer code or name. Created if unknown.

company.description: Selling company. Omit to use the configured default.

tax_id.description: Buyer VAT registration number. ZATCA requires 15 digits starting and ending with 3. Sending this is what makes the invoice a STANDARD (B2B) invoice.

buyer_id_type.description: ZATCA buyer identification scheme, for a B2B buyer with no VAT number. CRN = commercial registration, NAT = national id, IQA = iqama, PAS = passport.

buyer_id_value.description: The identifier itself. Required when buyer_id_type is sent.

posting_date.description: Invoice date, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

posting_time.description: HH:MM:SS. Goes into the ZATCA QR timestamp, so send the real time.

taxes.description: Omit to use the company's default tax template. ZATCA requires at least one tax row, so either send this or make sure a default template exists.

address_title.description: Title for the buyer address record.

address_display.description: Single free-text address line. Only use this if you cannot send address_parts; it has to be parsed with regexes and is less reliable.

return_against.description: The original invoice a credit note refers to. Must already be submitted. ZATCA requires a credit note to identify its original.

return_reason.description: Why the credit or debit note was issued. ZATCA rejects a credit note that does not state a reason (BR-KSA-17); it becomes the UBL InstructionNote. Falls back to remarks, then to a default.

payment_mode.description: Mode of payment, which supplies the ZATCA payment means code. Requires is_pos = 1, because ERPNext only stores payment rows on a POS invoice.

submit.description: Overrides the auto-submit setting. A ZATCA QR only exists for a submitted invoice, so leave this alone unless you specifically want a draft.

then.description: A buyer VAT number makes this a STANDARD invoice, and ZATCA rejects a standard invoice without a complete buyer address.

qty.description: Must not be 0. For a credit note send the quantity being returned; positive or negative both work, the sign is normalised.

rate.description: Unit price excluding VAT. Never negative -- use is_return.

item_tax_template.description: Per-line VAT treatment: the name of an existing Item Tax Template for the invoice's company. Send it on every line of any invoice that can mix standard, zero-rated or exempt items, and give each VAT category its own item_code -- one code across two templates collapses ERPNext's per-line tax detail, so ZATCA rejects the filing (BR-CO-14/BR-CO-15). Templates are never auto-created: an unknown name is a rejected request, nothing is written. Ask for the exact names, which carry the company abbreviation as a suffix. On a credit note, resend it per line; omitted, it is inherited from the invoice named in return_against.

account_head.description: Must be an account belonging to the invoice's company.

tax_amount.description: Only for charge_type Actual; every other type uses rate.

address.description: Buyer address. Every field marked required below is mandatory for a ZATCA STANDARD (B2B) invoice; ZATCA rejects the invoice if any is missing.
